subject: Urgent: audit pack request for runtime metrics and request traces
messages:
From: Alex Howard <alex@finco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Legal <legal@finco.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Production latency spike and missing traces

Soojin —

We saw a significant latency spike on FinCo's production traffic between ~07:50–08:05 UTC (roughly 500–1200ms p95 -> 2.4s p95 for a subset of inference routes). Several requests returned 502/503s and our product team observed repeated retries which amplified throughput. We need a formal extraction of the request traces and any server-side error logs for that window for our compliance review.

Please include: request IDs, model variant, region, routing decision, and any error stacks. Also let us know your log retention policy and whether token-level content is retained or redacted. FinCo Legal is cc'd.

Thanks,
Alex Howard
CTO, FinCo
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Howard <alex@finco.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike and missing traces

Alex / team —

Received. We're treating this as an incident escalation and will preserve all relevant telemetry. Immediate asks for the ops team:
- Pull request-level logs for 2026-11-29T07:40:00Z -> 2026-11-29T08:20:00Z across prod-us-1 and prod-us-2. Include: request_id, route, model_variant, node_id, latency_ms, status_code, and any server error text.
- Preserve the raw runtime logs and KV-cache snapshots for the implicated nodes; place under an incident hold (do not apply redaction until legal confirms).
- Note the S3 prefixes to preserve: s3://redwood-logs/prod/runtime/2026/11/29/ (runtime) and s3://redwood-logs/prod/traces/2026/11/29/ (traces).

Monica / Rishi — can you confirm chain-of-custody steps and surface the KMS key ID used to encrypt these logs? Also flag if any logs contain plaintext prompt/token data so we can advise FinCo Legal on redaction controls.

I'll coordinate the executive summary once we have the extracts.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Howard <alex@finco.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:05:12-08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike and missing traces

Soojin —

I've pulled an initial extract and attached a CSV with the request-level rows matching the window (see attachment). Quick notes:
- Attached: log-extract-2026-11-29.csv (request_id, ts_utc, route, model_variant, node_id, latency_ms, status_code, err_text).
- Storage/encryption: logs are encrypted using KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345; lifecycle policy moves raw logs to Glacier after 90 days by default.
- Token retention: by default we do not persist full plaintext prompt tokens in long-term indexes; however, transient runtime buffers may exist in the raw runtime logs for a short period. For incidents, we can snapshot and move the raw files to a legal-hold bucket (incident-archive/finco/2026-11-29/) where no lifecycle policies apply.
- Chain-of-custody: I captured the extraction job id (ext-job-20261129-007) and an MD5 manifest for the CSV. See query-ids.txt for the SQL query identifiers used to generate the extract.

Attachment: log-extract-2026-11-29.csv

I'll hold the raw files in the incident-archive path until Legal confirms redaction requirements.

—Rishi
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Howard <alex@finco.com>, FinCo Legal <legal@finco.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike and missing traces — incident evidence prepared

Alex / Legal team —

We have prepared the preliminary evidence pack for the 2026-11-29 latency incident and initiated an internal legal hold. Items included so far:
- Redacted request-level CSV (attached) and a sealed raw extract preserved in incident-archive/finco/2026-11-29/.
- Chain-of-custody manifest (chain_of_custody.txt) listing extraction job ids, operator IDs, timestamps, and MD5 checksums.
- Query identifiers for reproducibility (query-ids.txt).

Note on retention & redaction: our standard retention is 90 days, but the legal hold overrides lifecycle rules for the preserved prefix. If FinCo Legal requires token-level redaction before we transfer a copy to you, we'll need explicit redaction scope (fields, regex, or example samples). Otherwise, we can provide hashes of prompt text for matching without exposing raw prompts.

Next steps requested from FinCo: confirm whether you want raw extracts delivered as-is into a secure transfer bucket (AWS STS presigned link) or prefer us to run a redaction pass first. Please also indicate the minimum timeframe you require us to preserve the raw artifacts (we will hold until at least 2027-02-28 unless extended).

Attachments: chain_of_custody.txt, query-ids.txt

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Howard <alex@finco.com>, FinCo Legal <legal@finco.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Executive summary and delivery options for FinCo incident evidence pack

Alex / FinCo Legal —

Quick executive summary and choices for delivery:

What we preserved:
- Request-level logs covering 2026-11-29T07:40:00Z -> 2026-11-29T08:20:00Z (attached CSV excerpt).
- Raw runtime logs and trace snapshots moved to incident-archive/finco/2026-11-29/ (preserved under legal hold).
- Chain-of-custody manifest with extraction job ids and checksums.

Key security notes:
- Data-at-rest is encrypted with KMS (key id provided by Rishi). Access is restricted via IAM roles and audited via CloudTrail.
- Default retention is 90 days; legal hold prevents automatic lifecycle actions on preserved prefixes.
- Token-level plaintext is not indexed for search by default; raw runtime snapshots may contain transient buffers — we will not hand over raw tokens without FinCo Legal confirmation.

Delivery options (pick one):
A) Deliver raw extracts to a secure, short-lived S3 transfer bucket (we will provide a presigned STS URL). We will not redact before delivery.
B) Run a redaction-pass per FinCo-specified rules (you provide regex/fields) and deliver a redacted artifact.
C) Provide cryptographic hashes of prompt text and full request metadata (no plaintext prompts).

Please reply with preferred option and whether you need any additional audit artifacts (e.g., node-level disk images, network captures). We'll also prepare an auditable package for your external auditor (Audito LLP) if requested.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Related link: https://drive.redwood.internal/finco/incident-2026-11-29/audit-pack]
